Title: Azure Data Factory is now available in South Africa North

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory is now available in the South Africa North region. Provision Data Factory, Azure Integration Runtime, and SSIS Integration Runtime in the South Africa North region to co-locate your ETL logic with your data lake and compute.

Read more in the Data Factory blog.

Read the documentation.
